keyPoints.en: Density = population ÷ area. Malaysia's population is concentrated on the west coast of the Peninsula.
keyPoints.bm: Kepadatan = penduduk ÷ keluasan. Penduduk Malaysia tertumpu di pantai barat Semenanjung.

keyPoints.en: Factors: relief, resources, economic activities, transport, history.
keyPoints.bm: Faktor: bentuk muka bumi, sumber, kegiatan ekonomi, pengangkutan, sejarah.

keyPoints.en: Dispersed (scattered, farming), linear (along routes), nucleated (around a centre).
keyPoints.bm: Berselerak (bertaburan, pertanian), berjajar (di sepanjang laluan), berkelompok (di sekitar pusat).

keyPoints.en: Urbanisation is driven by rural–urban migration (push and pull factors).
keyPoints.bm: Perbandaran didorong oleh migrasi luar bandar–bandar (faktor tolakan dan tarikan).

keyPoints.en: Problems: congestion, squatters, pollution; villages face ageing populations.
keyPoints.bm: Masalah: kesesakan, setinggan, pencemaran; kampung menghadapi penduduk yang semakin tua.

keyPoints.en: Solutions: public transport, urban planning, rural development.
keyPoints.bm: Penyelesaian: pengangkutan awam, perancangan bandar, pembangunan luar bandar.
